newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens firm, selective squeeze carries on.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens firm, selective squeeze carries on.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index of leading UK shares started Friday's session higher as a squeeze in selected stocks continued, taking the overall market ahead, dealers said.
The index was 15.4 points up at 4,878.3 by 0742 GMT.
"There are too many shorts (short positions) out there for the market to come off. You can't really say this is down to the Dow because we ignored it yesterday and we are today," said a dealer.
The Dow finished 28.57 points ahead at 8,116.93.
Activity is seen subdued ahead of preliminary second quarter GDP figures due out at 0830 GMT.
